name: 晶莹易泡发雪燕慢炖羹款
description: 雪燕树胶干货套图模版：白底主图、玄底晶透氛围、泡发拉丝微距、四物搭配与信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-black #16130F for atmosphere heroes, warm paper beige #F5F1E8 for infographic and macro panels, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle speculars through the translucent gum, soft contact shadows, no harsh highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark rustic wood #2A2119, warm linen cloth and light matte stone #F2EDE4
styleLock.iconSystem: minimal thin-line callout marks in the amber accent only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered product placement, consistent scale across the set, product never covered by props
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium oriental tonic dry-goods visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal-black backdrop #16130F, warm paper beige #F5F1E8, amber gold accent #C89B5A and charcoal text #33302B; warm studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle speculars through the translucent gum and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line callout marks in the amber accent only; clean high-end food photography mixed with quiet infographic panels; stable centered product placement and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的干货主体
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product standing upright and centered, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, product fills the band cleanly
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the product standing upright and centered with its full silhouette visible and nothing clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, a soft front key with gentle fill, and a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace decoration. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no extra text, no fake logo, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no mould, no unrealistic portion size, no cut-off edges, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 9 屏逐屏事实：①玄黑底品名标题页，筷子夹起泡发后晶透胶条悬于陶碗上，深处有干货篮；②『无添加 易泡发』分栏页，黑碟上胶条拉丝，配红枣枸杞与针织布，下方两格泡发前后小图；③慢生活氛围页，木勺盛泡发胶质滴水微距，深底配绿叶；④『口感丝滑』竖排卖点页，木碗盛泡发胶质，暖木桌面配绿叶；⑤稀有度叙事页，筷子夹胶条悬于黑碟，配红枣；⑥食补叙事页，竹编篮盛干货胶质俯拍，桌面散落干料与草根；⑦木勺干货特写页，下接参数表（品名雪燕、规格、原料产地、贮存条件、生成日期、保质期）；⑧金标罐装图与皂角米/桃胶/雪燕/银耳四格组合图；⑨泡发炖煮分步说明页，含会员角标与二维码。品类判定：参数区品名为雪燕，是需长时间泡发再炖煮的树胶干货，非即食、非冲调饮品，也非生鲜粮油类普通农产品，全篇为滋补食补话术结构，参照燕窝类滋补干货先例改判为医药保健/营养补充。已剥离：罐身品牌字样与标签美术、会员角标与二维码、稀有度叙事与食补养颜类功效话术、规格/产地/保质期/泡发时长/水量/炖煮时长等全部数值（改为 {callout_n} 或空白占位行、空印章框、空时间槽），产品一律以 {product} 占位。
